ways.label: Full route: SH73 to Hawdon Shelter via Edwards Hut, Tarn Col and Walker Pass

start.name: SH73, 5 km south of Arthur's Pass village

end.name: Hawdon Shelter at the road end

via.name: East Branch of the Edwards River
via.quote: East Branch of the Edwards River

evidence: The Edwards valley end of the track starts beside SH73, 5 km south of Arthur’s Pass village, close to Greyneys Shelter.
5 km south of Arthur’s Pass village, cross the Bealey River just above its confluence with the Mingha River.
Recross the Hawdon and follow the river down the bush edge where a last crossing of the river is needed to reach the Hawdon Shelter at the road end.

ways.label: Easier overnight option: Hawdon Shelter to Hawdon Hut
evidence: For people with low-moderate tramping experience, the walk from Hawdon Shelter to Hawdon Hut is an easier overnight option.

doubts: Start: the text says the route starts beside SH73 close to Greyneys Shelter and crosses the Bealey River above the Mingha confluence; F2 (Mingha Track meets SH73) seems to be that crossing point but the text does not name the Mingha Track as the start, and F1 (Old Coach Road) is nearby. End: Hawdon Shelter at the road end has no feature (Mount White Road side). DOC gives no distance. W2's shape is not stated (an 'overnight option', presumably returning, but not said) and it has no time of its own; the 'Hawdon Hut site to Hawdon Shelter' section (3 hr) is that stretch walked the other way. The text recommends the Edwards-to-Hawdon direction but does not frame it as clockwise/anticlockwise.
